content:
Aria (Sales): Heads up — Orion.ai wants a live POC next week. They asked for a short very-high-throughput demo plus a longer smoke test on hosted. Can infra provision an ephemeral key + rate exception?
Ben (Infra): What are the numbers and windows?
Aria (Sales): Peak 600 rps for 10 minutes (demo), then 90 rps sustained for 4 hours (smoke). Streaming SSE preferred.
Noah (Platform): 600 rps even for 10m is heavy on hosted but we can do an ephemeral scoped key + a controlled burst window. Need IP allowlist or a proxy origin.
Maya (Security): Requirements: server-side calls only (static egress IPs), key TTL <= 72h, scope limited to generation only, logs redacted, and customer SOC contact on file.
Aria (Sales): They will egress from 203.0.113.0/24 and 203.0.114.0/24. TTL 48h is fine. SOC contact: sec@orion.ai.
Ben (Infra): I'll create an override: burst_rate=600 rps window=10m, sustained_rate=90 rps until end_time. I'll also bump concurrent streaming connections to 200 for this key. Need ticket with IPs + windows.
Zoe (SRE): I'll hook up an ad-hoc dashboard and set alerts to #eng-oncall: error_rate > 2% or p95 latency > 1.6s. Also will monitor connection churn for SSE.
Noah (Platform): Key scope will be generation:invoke only. Disable embeddings and rerank. Token tracing off, redaction on.
Maya (Security): Also disable export of raw payloads; retain access logs for 7 days for the POC only. Customer must confirm they won't proxy end-user browsers directly.
Aria (Sales): Demo window: 2028-06-12T09:00:00Z to 2028-06-12T13:00:00Z. Demo burst is 09:30 - 09:40Z. Smoke tests before from 08:00 - 08:45Z. Ticket created: REDWOOD-POC-508.
(15 minutes later)
deploy-bot: Ephemeral key provisioned: id ephem_c12f9, scope=generation:invoke, expires in 48h, IP allowlist applied. See REDWOOD-POC-508 for details.
Ben (Infra): Sample curl (replace <KEY>):
```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \ 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
 -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-7b","inputs":"generate recs","stream":true}'
```
Ben (Infra): Note: connection limit for this key increased to 200. For best throughput use multiple concurrent clients behind a connection pool.
Aria (Sales): Sending to customer now. They asked: if they sustained 90 rps for a month, ballpark cost?
Noah (Platform): Rough estimate: ~ $2.4k/mo for sustained 90 rps on rw-gpt-7b with our current token profile. I'll prepare a formal pricing note.
Zoe (SRE): Monitoring in place. I'll be on watch during the demo window. If sustained >90 rps outside demo, routing will failover to a lower-cost model (rw-gpt-3.5-small) automatically.
Orion (customer via email): Received key and smoke-tested at 560 rps streaming, no errors. Good to go.
Aria (Sales): Thanks team! Please flag if anything anomalous.
Ben (Infra): If errors spike we'll throttle and post updates in the ticket.
Maya (Security): All set from security side. Remember to delete the key after TTL.
Zoe (SRE): :eyes:
